newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech 1997 GDP growth seen at 2.0-3.0 pct -CSU.
newsitem.headline: Czech 1997 GDP growth seen at 2.0-3.0 pct -CSU.

text.p: The Czech Statistical Bureau (CSU) revised downwards on Monday its estimate for real GDP growth in 1997 to between 2.0 and 3.0 percent from a previous 2.9-3.5 percent.
In a wide range of economic forecasts, the CSU also said it expected average annual inflation to finish the year at 8.5-9.5 percent, revised from 8.2-8.8 percent.
